cards.front: Pensaba que yo era la única.
cards.back: I thought I was the only one.

cards.front: Pensaba que tenía que hacerlo yo.
cards.back: I thought I had to do it.

cards.front: Pensaba que había visto un gatito.
cards.back: I thought I saw a pussycat.

cards.front: Pensaba que lo sabías.
cards.back: I thought you knew.

cards.front: Pensaba que ya estabas allí.
cards.back: I thought you were there already.

cards.front: Pensaba que me querías.
cards.back: I thought you loved me.

cards.front: Pensaba que iba a llegar tarde.
cards.back: I thought I was going to be late.

cards.front: Pensaba que iba a perder este tren.
cards.back: I thought I was going to miss this train.

cards.front: Pensaba que iba a tener que comprar otro billete.
cards.back: I thought I was going to have to buy another ticket.

cards.front: Pensaba que los ibas a llamar tú.
cards.back: I thought you were going to phone them.

cards.front: Pensaba que ibas a quedarte en casa esta noche.
cards.back: I thought you were going to stay in tonight.

cards.front: Pensaba que te ibas a enfadar cuando te enteraste.
cards.back: I thought you were going to get angry when you found out.

cards.front: Yo pensaba eso también.
cards.back: I thought that too!

cards.front: Pensaba que sí.
cards.back: I thought so.

cards.front: Pensaba que no.
cards.back: I thought not.

cards.front: Después de mucho pensar, la policía decidió irrumpir en el apartamento.
cards.back: After much thought, the police decided to burst into the apartment.

cards.front: Después de mucho pensar, decidieron disparar al secuestrador en la pierna.
cards.back: After much thought, they decided to shoot the kidnapper in the leg.

cards.front: Después de mucho pensar, acordaron decirles a las familias de los secuestrados lo que sucedía.
cards.back: After much thought, they agreed to tell the hostages' families what was going on.

cards.front: Ahora mismo estaba pensando en pisotear esa araña peluda.
cards.back: I was just thinking about treading on that hairy spider.

cards.front: Ahora mismo estaba pensando en servirme un poco de vino tinto.
cards.back: I was just thinking about pouring myself some red wine.

cards.front: Ahora mismo estaba pensando en tejerle un jersey nuevo al bebé de Lisa.
cards.back: I was just thinking about knitting a new jumper for Lisa's baby.

cards.front: Tal y como pensé, van a derruir el viejo colegio para construir un centro comercial.
cards.back: Just as I thought, they're going to tear the old school down to build a shopping centre.

cards.front: Tal y como pensé, han instalado tres radares en el vecindario.
cards.back: Just as I thought, they've installed three speed radars in the neighbourhood.

cards.front: Tal y como pensé, van a construir más rotondas para frenar el tráfico.
cards.back: Just as I thought, they're going to build more roundabouts to slow the traffic down.

cards.front: Iba a rellenar el pavo con naranjas, pero cambié de opinión.
cards.back: I was going to stuff the turkey with oranges but thought better of it.

cards.front: Él iba a espolvorear azúcar glasé por encima de la tarta de zanahoria, pero cambió de idea.
cards.back: He was going to sprinkle some icing sugar over the carrot cake but thought better of it.

cards.front: Iban a trinchar el pavo en la cocina, pero cambiaron de idea y se lo llevaron a la mesa.
cards.back: They were going to carve the turkey in the kitchen but thought better of it and took it to the table.

cards.front: No se me ocurrió nada que decir cuando Susan me dijo que la habían despedido.
cards.back: I couldn't think of anything to say when Susan told me she had been made redundant.

cards.front: A ella no se le ocurrió nada más que comprarle a Tim por su cumpleaños, así que le invitó a cenar.
cards.back: She couldn't think of anything else to buy Tim for his birthday so she bought him dinner.

cards.front: No se les ocurrió nada mejor que mandarle unas flores a ella por el malentendido.
cards.back: They couldn't think of anything better to do than to send her some flowers for the misunderstanding.

cards.front: ¿Tienes buen concepto del gobierno y de la monarquía?
cards.back: Do you think highly of the government and the monarchy?

cards.front: Muchos clientes que compran en esa tienda tienen una opinión excelente de sus productos.
cards.back: Many customers who buy in that store think highly of the quality of their products.

cards.front: Su madre dice que debería casarse con alguien a quien admire.
cards.back: Her mother says she should marry someone she thinks very highly of.

cards.front: Le preocupa que la gente piense mal de ella cuando descubran lo que hizo.
cards.back: She's worried people will think badly of her when they find out about what she did.

cards.front: No me sorprende que piensen mal de él después de haber engañado a su hija.
cards.back: It doesn't surprise me they think badly of him after he cheated on their daughter.

cards.front: Tus verdaderos amigos nunca pensarán mal de ti, incluso si les decepcionas.
cards.back: Your true friends will never think badly of you even if you let them down.

cards.front: Él no tiene una buena opinión de la gente que miente para lograr sus metas.
cards.back: He doesn't think much of those people who lie in order to achieve their goals.

cards.front: La encuesta demostró que los trabajadores americanos no tienen una buena opinión de sus jefes.
cards.back: The survey showed American workers don't think much of their managers.

cards.front: No tengo una buena opinión de aquellos que ascienden solo porque recurren a sus contactos.
cards.back: I don't think much of those who are promoted just because they pull some strings.

cards.front: Él siente poco respeto por la gente que miente para lograr sus metas.
cards.back: He thinks little of those people who lie in order to achieve their goals.

cards.front: La encuesta demostró que los trabajadores americanos no sienten respeto por sus jefes.
cards.back: The survey showed American workers think little of their managers.

cards.front: No siento respeto por aquellos que ascienden solo porque recurren a sus contactos.
cards.back: I think little of those who are promoted just because they pull some strings.

cards.front: ¿Tú siempre piensas bien o mal de la gente?
cards.back: Do you always think the best or the worst of people?

cards.front: ¿Estás de acuerdo con el dicho «piensa bien de la gente a no ser que te demuestren lo contrario»?
cards.back: Do you agree with the saying "Think the best of others unless they prove otherwise"?

cards.front: No disfruto cuando estoy con él; siempre piensa mal de los demás.
cards.back: I don't enjoy being around him; he always thinks the worst of others.

cards.front: Todo el mundo dice que debería pensar en positivo, pero no es fácil.
cards.back: Everybody says I should think positively but it's not easy.

cards.front: ¿Cómo voy a pensar en positivo si he perdido todos mis ahorros?
cards.back: How am I going to think positively if I've lost all my savings?

cards.front: Te comprendo, yo no podría pensar en positivo después de algo así.
cards.back: I understand you, I couldn't think positively after something like that.

cards.front: Estoy cansadísimo y no puedo pensar con claridad.
cards.back: I'm knackered and can't think straight.

cards.front: Estoy tan cansado que no puedo pensar con claridad.
cards.back: I'm so worn out I can't think straight.

cards.front: Él dijo que estaba tan cansado que no podía pensar con claridad.
cards.back: He said he was so bushed he couldn't think straight.

cards.front: Peter es un cómico brillante porque tiene la habilidad de improvisar.
cards.back: Peter is a brilliant comedian because he has the ability to think on his feet.

cards.front: Los periodistas la bombardearon con preguntas, pero ella supo improvisar muy bien.
cards.back: The journalists bombarded her with questions but she was very good at thinking on her feet.

cards.front: Él no se había preparado bien, pero salió airoso porque sabe improvisar.
cards.back: He hadn't prepared his presentation well, but he came out of it with flying colours because he has the ability to think on his feet.

cards.front: Es una oradora magnífica porque tiene la habilidad de improvisar.
cards.back: She's an impressive speaker because she has the ability to think on the spot.

cards.front: Los periodistas le bombardearon con preguntas sobre su aventura, pero él supo salir del aprieto.
cards.back: The journalists bombarded him with questions about his affair but he was very good at thinking on the spot.

cards.front: Ella no se había preparado bien la entrevista, pero causó buena impresión por su habilidad para improvisar.
cards.back: She hadn't prepared the interview well but she made a good impression because of her ability to think on the spot.

cards.front: Lo que más les gustó del primer candidato fue su capacidad para ir más allá y proponer ideas divertidas.
cards.back: What they liked the most about the first candidate was his ability to think out of the box and come up with fun ideas.

cards.front: Aquella gente que quiere llegar lejos en la publicidad necesita ir más allá.
cards.back: Those people who want to get ahead in advertising need to think out of the box.

cards.front: Tania es una publicista fantástica porque siempre va más allá.
cards.back: Tania is a fantastic publicist because she's always thinking out of the box.

cards.front: El jefe de la oposición tiene pensado aumentar la edad de jubilación.
cards.back: The opposition leader is planning to raise the age of retirement.

cards.front: El alcalde tiene pensado cerrar diez guarderías en la ciudad.
cards.back: The mayor's planning to close down ten kindergartens in the city.

cards.front: Él y su equipo tienen pensado subir la tasa de basura.
cards.back: He and his team are planning to raise the garbage tax.

cards.front: El jefe de la oposición tenía pensado aumentar la edad de jubilación, pero cambió de opinión.
cards.back: The opposition leader was planning to raise the age of retirement but thought better of it.

cards.front: El alcalde tenía pensado cerrar diez guarderías en la ciudad, pero cambió de opinión.
cards.back: The mayor was planning to close down ten kindergartens in the city but thought better of it.

cards.front: Él y su equipo tenían pensado subir la tasa de basura, pero cambiaron de idea.
cards.back: He and his team were planning to raise the garbage tax but thought better of it.

cards.front: Pensamos ir a Bombay el 3 de julio.
cards.back: We plan to go to Mumbai on the 3rd of July.

cards.front: De ahí pensamos coger un tren a Udaipur.
cards.back: From there we plan to take a train to Udaipur.

cards.front: Pensamos quedarnos en casa de Meera mientras estamos en Udaipur.
cards.back: We plan to stay at Meera's place while we are in Udaipur.

cards.front: Esperamos llegar a Bombay el 3 de julio.
cards.back: We expect to arrive in Mumbai on the 3rd of July.

cards.front: De ahí esperamos coger un tren a Udaipur.
cards.back: From there we expect to take a train to Udaipur.

cards.front: Esperamos quedarnos en casa de Meera mientras estamos en Udaipur.
cards.back: We expect to stay at Meera's place while we are in Udaipur.

cards.front: No pienso disculparme por lo que hice.
cards.back: I don't intend to apologize for what I did.

cards.front: Ella no piensa perdonarte si no le pides disculpas.
cards.back: She doesn't intend to forgive you if you don't apologize to her.

cards.front: No piensan escucharles a ninguno de los dos hasta que hagan las paces.
cards.back: They don't intend to listen to either of them until they make up.

cards.front: Creo que necesito tiempo para reflexionar.
cards.back: I think I need some time to think it over.

cards.front: Reflexiona y luego vuelve con tu respuesta.
cards.back: Think it over and then come back to me with your answer.

cards.front: Dale tiempo para reflexionar antes de llamarle de nuevo.
cards.back: Give him time to think it over before calling him again.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no lo pensaste detenidamente primero?
cards.back: Why didn't you think it through first?

cards.front: La próxima vez, reflexiona sobre tu idea antes de presentarla.
cards.back: Next time, think your idea through before presenting it.

cards.front: ¿Realmente te has pensado bien esta idea?
cards.back: Have you really thought this idea through?

cards.front: ¿Qué diablos inventarán la próxima vez?
cards.back: What ever will they think up next?!

cards.front: ¿Cómo diablos has inventado semejante idea?
cards.back: How ever did you think up such an idea?

cards.front: Tenemos que inventar una excusa rápido.
cards.back: We have to think up an excuse quickly.

cards.front: Recuerda cuando eras niño; ¿alguna vez hablaste así a tus padres?
cards.back: Think back to when you were a child; did you ever talk like that to your parents?

cards.front: Recuerda la última vez que estuviste con él; ¿dijo algo extraño?
cards.back: Think back to when you were with him last; did he say anything strange?

cards.front: A menudo me acuerdo de cuando solíamos ir a remar juntos.
cards.back: I often think back to when we used to go rowing together.

cards.front: Siempre es una buena idea planear.
cards.back: It's always a good idea to think ahead.

cards.front: Tienes que planear si quieres tener éxito en los negocios.
cards.back: You have to think ahead if you want to succeed in business.

cards.front: Ya estoy pensando en las próximas Navidades.
cards.back: I'm already thinking ahead to next Christmas.
